report.summary: The investigation identified a critical fault in the payments service, specifically related to database connection pool exhaustion. The orders service was indirectly affected due to its dependency on payments, leading to elevated error rates and failed transactions. Key evidence includes repeated database timeout errors (LOG-01005, LOG-01022, LOG-01037, LOG-01073, LOG-01169, LOG-01191, LOG-01195, LOG-01208, LOG-01244) in the payments service, high database pool utilization (MET-00023), and upstream failure logs in orders (LOG-01178, LOG-01326, LOG-01408, LOG-01537). The dependency chain (DEP-004) confirms that orders calls payments, amplifying the impact of the pool exhaustion.
